note: Collected from docs/lanes/*_sources.md. Non-commercial/research data used for the prototype only; a paid pilot needs re-licensing or own data.

datasets.name: Uzbek_Plates v1, image AAF0119214_car-front_… (Damas van, front)
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0 (dataset README on the box: data/raw/ident_uz/roboflow_uzbek_plates/README.dataset.txt)
datasets.used_for: demo input "Car with an Uzbek plate"; recorded backup run
datasets.faces_plates: faces: n (checked visually); plates: y (public dataset)

datasets.name: "Chery A1 - service shop in Ukraine (7)", ANT Berezhnyi
datasets.used_for: demo input "Service bay: car on a lift"

datasets.name: "Classic Mustang at Garage, West Miami Florida August 2024", Phillip Pessar
datasets.used_for: demo input "Garage bay, car raised"

datasets.name: UA-DETRAC test sequence MVI_39051, frames 1–300, re-encoded to a 12 s H.264 mp4 (25 fps, 960×540)
datasets.used_for: demo video for the in-browser sampler; recorded backup run
datasets.faces_plates: faces: not identifiable at this resolution (traffic camera); plates: not legible

datasets.name: flower.jpg from scikit-learn sample images (vultilion on Flickr)
datasets.used_for: demo "not a car" input (unknown path)

datasets.name: UA-DETRAC (HF reformat abhineet123/ua_detrac, frames + boxes)
datasets.licence: Original licence not found (official site is down). The uploader tagged the HF repo cc-by-4.0, which does not override the original terms. Treat as evaluation / research only.
datasets.used_for: test (40 official test sequences: detection AP per weather, tracking), train (60 sequences, fine-tuning)

datasets.name: UA-DETRAC original XML annotations (weather label per sequence, vehicle type, ignored regions, speed)
datasets.licence: the uploader's note says CC-BY-NC-SA and that it is a private mirror; original licence not found
datasets.used_for: weather labels (sence_weather), vehicle types for fine-tuning classes, ignored regions, speeds

datasets.name: NDISPark
datasets.used_for: day (train split, 112 images) vs night (validation split, 30 images with boxes; test split 117 images with vehicle counts only); fine-tune on day split

datasets.name: PKLot
datasets.used_for: slot occupancy test and threshold calibration (PUCPR, UFPR04, UFPR05; sunny/cloudy/rainy), frames for router "street"

datasets.name: CNRPark+EXT (CNR-EXT full frames, slot boxes, labels)
datasets.used_for: slot occupancy cross-dataset test and calibration (sunny/overcast/rainy), router "street" frames
datasets.faces_plates: frames downsampled to 1000x750 "due to privacy issues"

datasets.name: MIO-TCD localization
datasets.used_for: cut: download (3.7 GB) was too slow on the shared drive and stopped at 1.6 GB, see notes

datasets.name: COCO val2017
datasets.licence: annotations CC BY 4.0; images are Flickr photos with mixed CC licences
datasets.used_for: person-AP regression check (zero-shot vs fine-tuned), router "street"/"motorcycle"/"unknown" images (never used to train a detector)

datasets.name: WIDER FACE (val, via HF CUHK-CSE/wider_face)
datasets.used_for: face-blur recall (test only)

datasets.name: Wikimedia Commons categories (repair shops, lifts, tyre shops, garages, car washes, boom barriers, car-park entrances, gatehouses, checkpoints, Ducati, scooters, car hoods/wheels/engines, a few non-car searches)
datasets.licence: per file: CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC0 / public domain etc. The exact licence, author and page URL of every image are in data/prep/flow/router/manifest.jsonl
datasets.used_for: router training + held-out evaluation
datasets.faces_plates: people and plates can appear in some images

datasets.name: Stanford Cars (HF tanganke/stanford_cars)
datasets.licence: Stanford Cars: research use, no explicit licence on the mirror
datasets.used_for: router "closeup" (whole-car photos)

datasets.name: Roboflow Universe Uzbek_Plates (suxrobs-workspace/uzbek_plates, version 1)
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0 (the roboflow licence field of the export)
datasets.used_for: detector train/val/test (boxes), real-UZ OCR test (301 original images, text labels made by us, see notes), pseudo-labelled OCR training crops (train split only)
datasets.faces_plates: plates yes (real Uzbek cars at an inspection-station-like site), faces no (a few people at the edge of some frames)

datasets.name: Mendeley Data "Dataset Of Central Asia vehicle number plate with Annotations" (v2)
datasets.used_for: background photos only for plate compositing: the zip has 502 JPEGs in per-country folders without any annotation file, and in the Uzbek folder the plates are blurred by the seller, so it cannot serve as plate ground truth

datasets.name: Wikimedia Commons, Uzbekistan car/plate categories + keyword searches (per-file licences in data/raw/ident_uz/commons/meta.jsonl on the box)
datasets.licence: per file: CC BY-SA 4.0 / CC BY 4.0 / CC BY-SA 3.0 / CC0 / public domain / CC BY 2.0 etc. (counted in the notes)
datasets.used_for: background photos for compositing; qualitative checks

datasets.name: CCPD2019 (Chinese City Parking Dataset) subsets ccpd_db, ccpd_weather, ccpd_challenge, ccpd_base
datasets.licence: MIT (GitHub licence of the CCPD repo); the HF mirror states no licence
datasets.used_for: detection robustness: night/bright/uneven illumination (DB), weather, challenge; Chinese plate formats (wrong script), so used for detection and compositing backgrounds only, never OCR

datasets.name: RodoSol-ALPR (Kaggle mirror tewjinglai/robosol: only cars-br and cars-me, 5,001 + 5,000 images; the motorcycle subsets are not in this mirror)
datasets.licence: academic/non-commercial research use under the authors' licence agreement (pdfs/license-agreement.pdf in the original repo); the Kaggle mirror itself states no licence
datasets.used_for: detection + OCR test (block-split test part), night/rain subset by measured luminance, composite backgrounds (train part)
datasets.faces_plates: plates yes, drivers' faces blurred by the authors

datasets.name: Unidata licence-plate sample (Kaggle unidpro/license-plate-detection-dataset, 3.7 MB)
datasets.licence: commercial dataset sample, licence not read in detail
datasets.used_for: downloaded, has no Uzbek images (Argentina, France, Mexico, Portugal only); not used, deleted

datasets.name: Kaggle valixonovilyosbek/cars-that-are-common-in-uzbekistan
datasets.used_for: inspected via file listing only: it is a Cityscapes-based Roboflow export, not Uzbek plates; not used

datasets.name: GitHub sardor-asatillaev/uzlpr, bekhzod-olimov/Synthethic-Uzbek-Car-Registration-Plates-Generator, IzzatulloOne/plate-recognition-uz
datasets.used_for: read only: plate-format rules (plate_rules.py regexes), series statistics sanity check; nothing from platesmania.com was downloaded; no code or glyph images copied

datasets.name: VehiDE (Kaggle copy of the official 13,945-image release, JSON train 11,621 + validation 2,324)
datasets.licence: Kaggle page label "Apache 2.0" (uploader); the paper states no licence. Treat as unclear.
datasets.used_for: damage: train/val (train JSON) and in-source test (official validation)

datasets.name: Humans in the Loop "Car Parts and Car Damages"
datasets.used_for: damage half (814 imgs): train/val/test; parts half (998 imgs): parts train/val/test

datasets.name: CarDD (via the Hugging Face FiftyOne mirror harpreetsahota/CarDD, 2,816 images = the official training portion)
datasets.licence: Research use only; prior consent from the PIC Lab (CAS) required; any commercial use incl. "testing commercial systems" needs authorisation; no transfer/distribution to third parties without authorisation (CarDD_license.pdf shipped in the mirror, signed by Voxel51, not by us). Obtained via the mirror at the integrator's instruction.
datasets.used_for: damage: train (model B only) + in-source test (cardd_test) + cross-source test for model A (cardd_trainpart)

datasets.name: Ultralytics carparts-seg (origin Roboflow car-seg, Gianmarco Russo)
datasets.used_for: parts: train/val/test (pooled and re-split by pHash cluster)

datasets.name: TyreNet (Mendeley 32b5vfj6tc)
datasets.used_for: tyre condition: train/val/in-source test

datasets.name: Roboflow dots-tracking/tire-dot-finder v5 (83) and kumbhar-saket/tyre-sidewall-text-label v5 ('dot' class only, train split)
datasets.used_for: DOT region detector: train/val

datasets.name: SYNDCAR
datasets.used_for: damage (4 classes, boxes) and parts (28 classes) cross-source test; damage->part assignment. Photos of ONE vehicle model (Citroen Ami, two vehicle IDs) with digitally generated damage (our reading; the page does not describe the method)
datasets.faces_plates: plates blurred in the photos we looked at; `license_plate` is a parts class

datasets.name: Kaggle Coco Car Damage
datasets.used_for: class-agnostic damage test (70 annotated images; the 8 'test' images ship without annotations)

datasets.name: Roboflow jijo/car-damage-new v2 (HF export JijoJS/car-damage-new1)
datasets.used_for: dent/scratch cross-source test (416x416 aspect-stretched)

datasets.name: CarDamagePanel (CMU 24-679 project, 565 imgs, 21 panels)
datasets.used_for: parts cross-source test

datasets.name: Kaggle warcoder/tyre-quality-classification
datasets.used_for: tyre condition cross-dataset test (after removing TyreNet near-duplicates)

datasets.name: Kaggle sameersambhare1/tyre-condition-classification-dataset
datasets.used_for: tyre condition cross-dataset test (NEW + SERVICEABLE = good, UNUSABLE = defective, our mapping)

datasets.name: Roboflow subhams-workspace-l47ut/dot-code-6shg0 (97)
datasets.used_for: DOT region detector cross-source test
